user_query: I'm organizing a football tournament in Peru and I need some details. Can you fetch the competitions and teams of televised football matches in the country? Additionally, provide me with the team receiving data, passing data, and win data from the NFL Team Stats_v2 API to analyze the performance of the teams.

TaskList.description: 查询秘鲁境内的足球比赛信息，包括比赛列表和相关的参赛队伍，特别是电视转播的比赛。
调用NFL Team Stats_v2 API，获取特定球队的接球数据、传球数据和胜利数据，用于分析球队表现。
required_inputs: 数据类型: receiving, passing, win
